author: everestmcarthur
install_msg:
Thanks for installing **SelfbotGuard v1.2.0** — 14-layer selfbot detection & punishment.

Get started: `[p]sbguard enable` to turn it on, `[p]sbguard action <action>` to set punishment.

Detection: rich-embed abuse, inhuman response speed, timing precision, 24/7 activity, pattern matching, burst detection, cross-channel spam, cross-server simultaneous activity, edit cadence, presence anomalies, reaction sniping, formatting analysis, trigger-word sniping, and self-delete patterns.

Cog is *disabled by default* — enable per-server.
name: SelfbotGuard
short: Advanced selfbot detection with configurable per-server punishments.
description: SelfbotGuard v1.2.0 detects Discord selfbots using 14 heuristic layers: rich-embed abuse, inhuman response-time analysis, message-timing precision, 24/7 activity profiling, automated command-response patterns, rapid-fire burst detection, cross-channel spam (same message blasted across channels), cross-server simultaneous activity (messages in different servers within impossible windows), edit cadence analysis, presence anomalies (messaging while offline/invisible), reaction speed sniping, suspiciously clean formatting at speed, trigger-word sniping (giveaway/nitro/etc.), and self-delete patterns. Each heuristic contributes to a cumulative suspicion score per user. When the score exceeds a configurable threshold, the bot takes action: warn, mute/timeout, kick, ban, or log-only. No exceptions.
end_user_data_statement: This cog stores Discord user IDs and guild IDs for selfbot detection. Per-user data includes message timestamps, response timing, activity windows, and suspicion scores. Data is used solely for detection heuristics and is periodically pruned.
